An unexpected event on the day of their granddaughter's engagement leads a nonagenarian couple on a journey that tests their familial bonds.
Vishnu gets acquainted with Raghu during a trip and learns that he is rich and is returning home after 16 years. Then, Vishnu pushes Raghu into a ravine and goes to his house pretending to be him.
Trainee detectives Unnikrishnan, Prem and Ommen try their best to outdo each other and investigate a case in order to get employed at a private detective agency.

Sethunath is a successful writer who shares the story of his life with journalist Aneesa. He talks about falling in love with Priya and his inability to marry her because of his estranged wife, Manju.

Building contractor Nambiar learns that his spate of bad luck is due to a statue kept at home. He succeeds in transferring his misfortune to his rival, but the statue finds its way back into his life.
A thief who calls himself Arakallkan threatens a woman named Maala that he will steal her necklace. However, things turn tricky when another robber named Mukkalkallan challenges him.

Anoop, who wants to pursue an MBA, is forced to take up a job as a teacher. However, his life changes when he finds himself drawn to the headmistress of the school that he works at.

Vishnu, a policeman, leads a happy life with his wife, Gayathri, until he is murdered in cold blood, and she is raped. However, she vows revenge and returns with a new identity to punish the culprits.
Sumathi, a poor girl, is forced by her parents to marry Sukumaran, a rich man. However, her marital life turns upside down after she learns that her husband is a pimp.
Appukuttan impersonates his twin brother and takes up the job of beating up some men for a lodge owner. However, problems arise when he falls in love with his boss's daughter.
As the new caretaker of a palace that is under dispute over its ownership, Anantha, an advocate, must ensure the property remains safe.
Sameera, an Indian nurse working in Iraq, and her colleagues are held hostage by terrorists. Later, Indian ambassador Manoj uses his wit to rescue them and get them out of the country alive.
Nityananda Shenoy, a gangster from Kasaragod, decides to exact revenge on an ex-minister who swindled him right before demonetisation. Meanwhile, Muthuvel and his mother struggle to survive in Kochi.
A musically gifted man pretending to be a priest wins hearts in a royal household, but buried family secrets and a long-lost connection soon stir tension beneath the festivities.
Black is Tharakan's servant who has an obsession for black clothes. His life changes when Meenakshi arrives at Tharakan's house and begins to unravel mysteries of his dark past.
Alice, a young teacher, is in love with Captain Thomas. However, Thomas suspects that Alice is having an illicit affair with Ravi, one of her students.
